notes.title: 1.6 the new update is live
notes.content:
Hello Wacky Wizarding Players, it has been 386 days since the last update. This 'update' has seen the entire game get rebuilt from the ground up and includes brand new code and many new sprites. Several things from previous versions have yet to be reimplemented but there is still more content than in previous versions (probably).

Here is a list of some changes that I can remember:

[b]Removed features (don't worry they'll be back eventually):[/b]
- Removed Wilbur and associated items
- Removed Slime area and associated enemies / items
- Removed Bats (Bats will not be returning ever)
- Removed Poop Salesman and money
- Removed several items which were boring

[b]Items:[/b]
- Potions now have horrible side effects when consumed in quick succession, they also have fun animations
- Hats are now separate from upgrades and you can only use one at a time
- Healing potions can now be consumed repeatedly at the cost of efficiency, numbness, and increased risk of bleeding
- Toughness potions reduce incoming damage and can decrease reaction time
- Speed potions make you go fast but also fidgety (they can also cause death if you stop moving)
- Added lucky drinking hat which prolongs potion effects
- Added wandslingers hat which decreases item use time
- Added Outback hat which makes projectiles behave like boomarangs
- Added barbed wire upgrade which damages nearby enemies when nearby enemies damage you
- Added Medkit which restores health passively if you don't take damage for a while
- Added Magic Teapot (again) which deals more damage as it is used
- Added bubble wand which creates bubbles that float in place for awhile
- Added fork which fires 3 projectiles at once (replacement for magic shotgun)
- Added celestial staff which causes stars to fall on the cursor

[b]Enemies:[/b]
- Updated sprites for all enemies
- Added Rat Gargoyles (replacement for bats which were not rats and also not interesting)
- Added Rat Bombs which explode
- Added Ratsalisks which are snakes
- Massively changed Rat King
- Rat knights now only spawn during rat king fight
- Added Rat bag who is exclusively used in the tutorial

[b]Other stuff:[/b]
- Added very useful tutorial
- Changed many visual aspects of the game

Please join the discord server to give any feedback or suggestions:
https://discord.gg/MTGtnGyyze

P.S. Early Access is over

notes.title: Wacky Wizarding Dungeon 1.4 is here
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's been a hot minute since the last update, so long in fact that I've forgotten exactly what has changed since then and most of it is backend stuff I won't bore you with, but I'll attempt to write a changelog nonetheless.

[b]Changes in 1.4[/b]
- New menu screen and pause menu
- You're now able to change keybinds
- The dungeon looks different (remember last update when I changed worldgen? well it's now completely different)

[b]Additions in 1.4:[/b]
- 6 new enemies (although one of them barely counts as new) including a new boss
- A new area (and a new song to go along with it)
- A few new items
- Upgrades - Upgrades are new items that become bound to the player and change some trait about them (damage reduction, mana consumption, etc.), these effects can be good or bad and will usually stack if you have multiple of the same upgrade, there are currently about 8 upgrades currently but more will be added as time goes on
- 2 new achievements, one is a secret

That's all of the content stuff, I'm sorry it took so long to get this update finished I didn't want to release an update that was just technical stuff that didn't affect anyone but me, but now that that's all finished even more new updates should be coming soon - and I'm thinking that the time between this update and the last one will be greater than the time between the full release and now.

Have fun with the new stuff - Shoe & CO

notes.title: Beta 1.3, The 'Wacky WorldGen' Update is here
notes.content:
This is probably the biggest update we've released yet, so some things may be left out of the changelog because I've forgotten entirely about them.

[b]Changes in Beta 1.3[/b]
- Camera issues fixed
- Rooms now have only a 1 in 5 chance to spawn chests rather than spawning them 100% of the time
- Rooms now have a chance to be refought, upon entering a cleared room there is a 1 in 10 chance for the room to spawn more enemies and lock the doors. Refighting a room has a 1 in 5 chance to spawn a chest so long as a chest has not already spawned in the room
- Increased most enemies' damage and health
- Made weapon modifiers have a more intense affect weapons
- Increased mana cost for most weapons
- Tweaked healing potions to restore 25 health and have a 15 second cooldown
- The player now starts with 10 healing potions instead of 5
- The Poop salesman is now able to speak

[b]Changes to WorldGen in Beta 1.3[/b]
- The Dungeon will no longer generate 'infinitely' making the Poop Emporium much easier to find
- Signs pointing toward the Poop Emporium can be found throughout the dungeon
- Dead ends will occasionally spawn with cracks in them, attacking the wall will reveal a secret room

[b]Additions[/b]
- Added a weapon called 'The Dungbell' which deals damage based on how close you are to an enemy, and ignores enemy damage reduction
- Added a potion that reduces mana usage by 60% for 30 seconds
- Added a potion that reduces incoming damage by 45% for 30 seconds
- Added ambient music
- Added 4 achievements

Please consider joining our discord server if you haven't already https://discord.gg/Epx3pkf

That should (probably) be everything, please report any bugs on our discord server.
